Hi Marissa,

Great to hear — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers from procurement/legal side:
- Helix does require a signed DPA before any production data is sent. We review standard vendor DPAs; minor edits are usually OK but redlines need to be scoped to keep things moving.
- We will provide an official subprocessor list. For initial review, please include your standard subprocessors and any cloud provider relationships (compute, monitoring, storage).
- Typical retention policy: diagnostics/logs 1 year by default; customer content retention depends on contract — budgeting for 7 years is conservative if you need long-term storage, but our default is often 2–3 years unless regulated. Can you confirm Redwood's default retention?
- PO process: Helix Procurement issues a PO after contract signature. We need billing address + W-9 for vendor setup. Net 30 is our default; exceptions can be requested.

I'll loop in procurement (procurement@helixanalytics.com) to keep the intake moving. We aim to return the DPA review within 3 business days.

Hi all,

Thanks for the context, Marissa and Sarah. Attaching our standard DPA (DPA_template_redwood.pdf) and a redacted SOC2 snapshot (SOC2_snapshot_2025.pdf) for Helix's review. A few notes from legal:

- DPA: Our standard template covers subprocessors, security measures, breach notification timelines, and data subject rights. Small revisions are usually acceptable, but please flag any substantive redlines early so we can triage.
- Subprocessors: We publish an up-to-date subprocessor register on request. Helix — please confirm if you require us to list all sub-processors up front or a rolling disclosure is acceptable. If you need contract-level subprocessor commitments, let us know.
- Retention: Redwood's default diagnostic/log retention is 12 months; customer content retention is configurable per contract (we typically suggest 2–3 years unless a specific regulated retention is required). If Helix anticipates longer retention for audit/history, we can include a clause that specifies the agreed term.
- PO/Billing: Laura — please confirm Redwood's vendor setup fields (billing address, TAX ID/W-9, invoice contacts) and whether Finance can accept Helix's PO template.

Action items:
- Helix: please return a subprocessor list and indicate the desired retention period for customer content.
- Marissa/Laura: confirm if we should send the DPA via DocuSign (preferred) and whether the SOC2 snapshot suffices for initial procurement review.
